desc: Treasure chests in the pocket netherworld base, 3 per chapter, visible in a story-flag window.

fields.name: pos_x
fields.desc: x position on the base map

fields.name: pos_y
fields.desc: y position on the base map

fields.name: opened_flag
fields.desc: FLAG_TOWN_TREASURE_START(2600)+id: set when the chest is opened

fields.name: show_flag
fields.desc: chest appears after this scenario flag (-1 = from start), e.g. 199 = ep.1 clear

fields.name: hide_flag
fields.desc: chest disappears after this scenario flag (-1 = never)

fields.name: treasure_id
fields.desc: always equal to opened_flag (2600+id); contents lookup id?
